support_floor.power: AC power, Low Power Mode off, nominal thermal state

validation_policy: Hybrid: GitHub-hosted macos-14 M1/7-GB constrained evidence for deterministic non-interactive metrics; explicitly post_event_tap_synthetic signed-app typed-hotkey-callback/overlay/paste evidence with a fixture-backed recording source; and a supported physical Apple-Silicon Mac for Instruments and display interaction. Post-event-tap synthetic evidence is never relabeled as physical, event-tap, microphone, TCC or M06 human proof.

workload.default_model: Parakeet TDT 0.6B int8 at immutable revision 8f23f0c03c8761650bdb5b40aaf3e40d2c15f1ce

budgets.rationale: Cold LaunchServices startup must become a usable menu-bar process within two seconds on the support floor.
Warm LaunchServices startup must settle within one second.
After the production event-tap boundary, recording feedback must feel immediate and stay below the perceptible interaction boundary.
The fixed Parakeet fixture must reach successful production Cmd+V dispatch within three seconds of typed release-handler ingress; target insertion remains M07 human acceptance.
An idle budget is valid only after a continuous thirty-minute residency.
A menu-bar app must be effectively quiescent while idle.
Normal housekeeping must not produce sustained idle CPU bursts.
Idle polling and timers are limited to two package-idle wakeups per second on average.
Occasional housekeeping may burst but must remain bounded.
The Activity Monitor energy proxy must remain negligible during residency.
Idle energy spikes must not resemble foreground work.
The active capture budget covers one continuous sixty-second recording.
Capture and Opus work must leave substantial CPU headroom on base M1.
Recording energy must stay proportional to light real-time audio work.
Inference may use the eight-core base M1 but must not exceed its available CPU envelope.
Inference energy is allowed to be bursty but remains bounded to the base-M1 CPU envelope.
The single clean constrained run measures the normal 640 MiB pinned-model download, integrity verification and atomic publication on the declared link before the 20-cycle workload.
The same clean constrained run measures cold load/prewarm separately from download before reusing exactly one engine for 20 cycles.
Settings route changes stay within the direct-manipulation response boundary.
A full retained history must render without perceptible blocking.
Interactive navigation and history scrolling must sustain at least 30 fps at p95.
No main-thread stall above 100 ms is accepted during the scripted UI workload.
The scripted Settings and 50-row History workload leaves main-thread headroom for input and AppKit.
Audio-level updates must remain in their narrow presentation path and never rebuild the full screen tree.
The loaded default model leaves more than three quarters of an 8 GiB machine available to macOS and other apps.
Transient model and transcription allocations must not pressure an 8 GiB support-floor machine.
Descriptor usage stays far below the process limit and exposes leaked recordings, databases or trace handles.
Thread pools remain bounded across the Swift, GPUI, audio and ONNX layers.

Constrained growth evidence requires exactly twenty sequential fixture transcriptions through the signed AppModel/runtime with one warmed engine; real microphone/paste cycles remain separate physical supporting evidence.
History rendering evidence uses the complete fifty-entry retention workload.
Post-warmup retained memory growth is bounded across twenty cycles.
A low positive slope catches leaks even when end-point noise remains inside the absolute allowance.
No recording, database or paste descriptor family may leak per cycle.
Thread pools settle after warmup and do not multiply with each inference.
RSS, descriptors and threads must not rise at every one of the final ten cycle boundaries.

budgets.unit: new definite leaks after 20 closed cycles
budgets.rationale: Identical stack-logged pre/post scans must add no definite leaks across 20 app-correlated cycles. The evidence-backed startup baseline is 2 CFString / 112 bytes in cpal Device::name -> CoreAudio and is tracked non-blockingly as wrenflow-bda; total leak count is never mislabeled zero.
